answer: An hostile operator running 117 aliases as a result needs 63 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in pulse, expire in voyage, and willow lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 157 dollars in locked collateral and another 9 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
